claim: Use __sdcccall(1) per function, not globally: -Cs"--sdcccall 1" links but calls library helpers such as __mullong with register args while the library takes stack args, giving garbage.

evidence.text: Global --sdcccall 1 linked but gave garbage results from library helpers; __sdcccall(1) functions clean the stack themselves only if non-variadic and returning void or at most 16 bits.
